name: m3 Memory
summary: Local-first, MCP-native memory layer for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, OpenCode, OpenClaw) with hybrid search and chat capture.
description: `pipx install m3-memory`, then `m3 setup` detects installed agents and wires m3 into each (MCP config plus session-start and chat-capture hooks), and `m3 doctor` checks the install. Stores facts, decisions, preferences and conversation history locally with hybrid search (SQLite FTS5 + vectors + MMR); works fully offline, needs no cloud account or API key, and can optionally use a local LLM (Ollama, LM Studio) to summarize and link memories. The project reports 99.2% LongMemEval-S retrieval at k=8 (self-reported). Python 3.12+; PyPI `m3-memory` 2026.10.25.0.
